{"type_map": {},
  "constraints": [
    {"id": "R1", "category": "count_semantics",
     "alternatives": ["(df['sloss'] <= df['spkts']) & (df['dloss'] <= df['dpkts'])"],
     "features": ["sloss", "spkts", "dloss", "dpkts"],
     "rationale": "Retransmitted or dropped packets are a subset of total packets sent in each direction, so loss counts cannot exceed total packet counts."},
    {"id": "R2", "category": "count_semantics",
     "alternatives": ["(df['sloss'] >= 0) & (df['dloss'] >= 0)"],
     "features": ["sloss", "dloss"],
     "rationale": "Loss counts represent the number of retransmitted or dropped packets and cannot be negative."},
    {"id": "R3", "category": "count_semantics",
     "alternatives": ["(df['spkts'] >= 0) & (df['dpkts'] >= 0)"],
     "features": ["spkts", "dpkts"],
     "rationale": "Packet counts are non-negative integers by definition."},
    {"id": "R4", "category": "count_semantics",
     "alternatives": ["(df['ct_flw_http_mthd'] >= 0) & (df['ct_ftp_cmd'] >= 0) & (df['ct_srv_src'] >= 0) & (df['ct_srv_dst'] >= 0) & (df['ct_dst_ltm'] >= 0) & (df['ct_src_ltm'] >= 0) & (df['ct_src_dport_ltm'] >= 0) & (df['ct_dst_sport_ltm'] >= 0) & (df['ct_dst_src_ltm'] >= 0) & (df['ct_state_ttl'] >= 0)"],
     "features": ["ct_flw_http_mthd", "ct_ftp_cmd", "ct_srv_src", "ct_srv_dst", "ct_dst_ltm", "ct_src_ltm", "ct_src_dport_ltm", "ct_dst_sport_ltm", "ct_dst_src_ltm", "ct_state_ttl"],
     "rationale": "All connection-count features are defined as counts of connections or flows and must be non-negative."},
    {"id": "R5", "category": "count_semantics",
     "alternatives": ["(df['is_ftp_login'].isin([0, 1])) & (df['is_sm_ips_ports'].isin([0, 1]))"],
     "features": ["is_ftp_login", "is_sm_ips_ports"],
     "rationale": "Binary indicator features are defined to take exactly the value 0 or 1."},
    {"id": "R6", "category": "count_semantics",
     "alternatives": ["(df['trans_depth'] >= 0) & (df['response_body_len'] >= 0)"],
     "features": ["trans_depth", "response_body_len"],
     "rationale": "Transaction depth and response body length are non-negative counts/sizes by definition."}
  ]
}
